reproduction_instructions.description: Run the experiment script to reproduce all measurements
reproduction_instructions.dependencies: pip install brotli requests pyjwt numpy
reproduction_instructions.notes: Experiment uses localhost mock server + CDN quality proxy. All ports are unique per content type x size combination. Quality RNG uses independent seed (SEED+7919) from request ordering (SEED=44).

architecture.description: Two-layer architecture: Mock OAuth2 Server (uncompressed) -> CDN Quality Proxy (random brotli quality) -> Client
architecture.mock_server: Returns UNCOMPRESSED bodies per auth state. No compression applied.
architecture.cdn_proxy: Intercepts responses, re-compresses with random brotli quality from {4,5,6,7,8} per request. Independent RNG for quality selection.
architecture.client: Python requests library. SHA256 decompression-normalization applied after decoding.
architecture.quality_variation: Uniform random from {4,5,6,7,8} per request, independent of auth state, content type, and payload size.

key_findings: Decompressed body-only discrimination = 0.5000 across all 9 content-type x size combinations under non-deterministic brotli quality
All 5 quality levels {4,5,6,7,8} observed across all conditions, confirming CDN proxy quality variation is active
Decompressed hashes remain perfectly stable (1 unique per state, all_same=true) despite quality variation
Compressed-only discrimination is lower (0.16-0.35 vs 0.50 decompressed), confirming decompression is necessary for quality-invariance
B-RANDOM = 0.0000 across all conditions (null control passes)
